input: Why do companies build in-house models, and how do customer insight and privacy/security drive it?
actual_output:
Companies build in-house models to have better control over their technology and to understand their customer base better. When companies create their own models, they can tailor them to meet the specific needs and preferences of their users. - **Harnesses** keep the engineering layer yours—memory, tool calling, prompts, and context—so you can swap the underlying model if needed.
- **Routing** automatically sends requests to another model if one is banned, unavailable, or overloaded.

So overall, the **model can change**, but your **system keeps running**.
